verdict.rationale: Fellow's docs say it records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, either via a visible bot or botless desktop audio capture. Users can choose when to record, pause, or resume, and admins can set organization-wide recording policies, which covers "recording where I want it." The Recordings API also captures the Zoom, Meet, and Teams call URLs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of capture reliability across the three platforms, since all evidence is vendor-claimed.
